integrity: All formulas and proof given for complex projective toric varieties. Finite exact Jacobian checks supplement, but do not replace, the all-parameter proof. Earlier graph-theoretic and determinantal results are credited. No independent mathematical validation has been carried out.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies codimension-three singular components and their generic transverse analytic type; it does not classify singular components in higher codimension, non-generic intersections, or non-reduced singular schemes.
title: Three node-type families in theta-graph edge toric varieties
